description: Independent AnySearch integration for public web research, parallel searches, source verification, and Chinese/English prior-art evidence comparison.

defaultPrompt: Use AnySearch to find Chinese and English sources on this technical topic, with original links and publication dates.
Use AnySearch to search for a single prior-art document disclosing every feature of the following novelty claim.
Use AnySearch to search five distinct angles in parallel, deduplicate the findings and verify the most relevant pages.
